subject: general
question: According to Article 24 of the Indian Constitution, what is the minimum age for employment in factories or mines or other hazardous employment?
solution:
The correct answer is __14 years.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 24 of the Indian Constitution__ prohibits the employment of children below the age of 14 years in factories or mines or in any other hazardous employment.
 
• It is a part of the Directive Principles of State Policy, aimed at ensuring the well-being of children.
 
• This provision is intended to protect children from exploitation and hazardous working conditions.
 
• The Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986 was enacted to enforce this constitutional provision.
 
• The act specifies the types of employment that are prohibited for children.
 
• Violation of this provision can lead to penalties for employers, including fines and imprisonment.
 
• It ensures children's right to education and a safer childhood.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act:**

 
 
• This act prohibits the employment of children in hazardous occupations.
 
• It also regulates the working conditions of children in non-hazardous occupations.
 
 
 
• **Right to Education Act:**
 
 
• This act ensures free and compulsory education for children aged 6 to 14 years.
 
• It complements the provisions of Article 24 by promoting education over child labour.
